title.en: How to Get a Claude Fable 5 API Key — Anthropic's Most Powerful Public Model (2026)
title.zh: 如何获取 Claude Fable 5 API Key——Anthropic 当前最强公开模型（2026）

excerpt.en: Claude Fable 5 is Anthropic's first Mythos-class model available to the public — released June 9, 2026. It leads every major benchmark including SWE-bench Verified (95.0%) and GPQA Diamond (92.8%). This guide covers registration, key creation, your first API call with adaptive thinking, error fixes, and a full pricing comparison.
excerpt.zh: Claude Fable 5 是 Anthropic 首款对公众开放的 Mythos 级模型，2026 年 6 月 9 日正式发布，SWE-bench Verified 达 95.0%，GPQA Diamond 达 92.8%，领跑所有主流基准测试。本指南涵盖注册、创建密钥、首次调用（含自适应思考）、报错排查及完整定价对比。

en: On June 9, 2026, Anthropic released Claude Fable 5 alongside Claude Mythos 5. Both models share the same underlying architecture (internally codenamed "Capybara"), but Mythos 5 is restricted to government and security institutions, while Fable 5 is Anthropic's most capable model available to the general public.

Fable 5 belongs to the new Mythos-class tier — a step above the Opus tier that previously represented Anthropic's flagship. The name itself reflects this: Fable (from Latin fabula, meaning 'a told story') is the publicly-accessible, safety-guardrailed version of the Mythos foundation. Fable 5 retains the full reasoning and capability of the Mythos base, with safety classifiers layered on top for commercial deployment.

Fable 5 is designed specifically for long-running, autonomous, multi-step tasks — the kind that previously required frequent human check-ins. It features native adaptive thinking (always-on, not a toggle), a 1 million token context window, and multimodal vision support. On Cursor's internal CursorBench for real-world software engineering, Fable 5 scores higher than every other available model.
zh: 2026 年 6 月 9 日，Anthropic 同时发布了 Claude Fable 5 和 Claude Mythos 5。两款模型共享相同的底层架构（内部代号 Capybara），但 Mythos 5 仅定向开放给政府和安全机构；Fable 5 是 Anthropic 向公众开放的最强模型。
Fable 5 属于全新的 Mythos 级别——比原旗舰 Opus 级别高一档。命名寓意鲜明：Fable（拉丁语 fabula，意为「被讲述的故事」）是 Mythos 基座的公开、安全版本，在保留 Mythos 全部推理和能力的基础上，叠加了商业部署所需的安全分类器。
Fable 5 专为长时间运行、自主、多步骤的任务而设计——这类任务此前往往需要频繁的人工介入。它具备原生自适应思考（始终开启，无需手动切换）、100 万 Token 上下文窗口，以及多模态视觉理解能力。在 Cursor 针对真实软件工程场景的 CursorBench 基准中，Fable 5 得分高于所有其他可用模型。

heading.zh: 2）基准测试表现——Fable 5 的能力位置

en: Fable 5 achieves state-of-the-art results across software engineering, scientific reasoning, and agentic tasks. On SWE-bench Verified — the gold standard for real-world code bug resolution — Fable 5 scores 95.0%, compared to 69.2% for Claude Opus 4.8 and 58.6% for GPT-5.5.

On FrontierCode Diamond, a benchmark for high-difficulty programming problems, Fable 5 scores 29.3% — more than twice Opus 4.8's 13.4% and five times GPT-5.5's 5.7%. On GPQA Diamond (advanced scientific reasoning), Fable 5 reaches 92.8%. A real-world demonstration: Fable 5 completed a 50-million-line Ruby migration in a single day — a task previously requiring a large engineering team over weeks.

These benchmarks confirm that Fable 5 is not an incremental upgrade from Opus 4.8 — it represents a qualitative leap, particularly in tasks that require multi-step planning, sustained context, and code execution over long sessions.
zh: Fable 5 在软件工程、科学推理和 Agent 任务三大方向均取得了最先进的成绩。在 SWE-bench Verified（衡量真实代码缺陷修复能力的权威基准）上，Fable 5 得分 95.0%，而 Claude Opus 4.8 为 69.2%，GPT-5.5 为 58.6%。
在 FrontierCode Diamond（高难度编程题基准）上，Fable 5 得分 29.3%，是 Opus 4.8（13.4%）的两倍多，GPT-5.5（5.7%）的五倍。在 GPQA Diamond（高阶科学推理）上达到 92.8%。真实案例印证：Fable 5 单日完成了 5000 万行 Ruby 代码迁移——这项工作此前需要大型工程团队数周才能完成。
这些数据证明 Fable 5 并非 Opus 4.8 的小步升级，而是质的跨越，尤其体现在需要多步规划、长时间保持上下文和执行代码的任务上。

en: SWE-bench Verified: 95.0% (Opus 4.8: 69.2% | GPT-5.5: 58.6%)
FrontierCode Diamond: 29.3% (Opus 4.8: 13.4% | GPT-5.5: 5.7%)
GPQA Diamond (science): 92.8% — leading all public models
Hebbia Finance Benchmark: #1 across all tested models
Remote agentic automation accuracy: 16.1%
zh: SWE-bench Verified：95.0%（Opus 4.8：69.2% | GPT-5.5：58.6%）
FrontierCode Diamond：29.3%（Opus 4.8：13.4% | GPT-5.5：5.7%）
GPQA Diamond（科学推理）：92.8%，领跑所有公开模型
Hebbia 金融推理基准：所有测试模型中第一
远程 Agent 自动化任务准确率：16.1%

en: Visit console.anthropic.com and sign up with your email address. Google single sign-on is also supported. Once registered, you will be prompted to complete phone number verification — this is required to activate API access and prevents abuse.

After verification, you need to add a credit card or purchase credits before generating API keys. Anthropic does not offer a permanent free tier for the API, but new accounts occasionally receive a small starter credit. Check the console dashboard for any active promotions after signing up.

Note for users outside the US: Anthropic's API is available globally. The June 2026 US export control incident that briefly suspended access for some countries was resolved on July 1, 2026, and international access has been fully restored.
zh: 访问 console.anthropic.com，使用邮箱注册，也支持 Google 一键登录。注册后需完成手机号验证——这是激活 API 访问的必要步骤，用于防止滥用。
验证完成后，需要绑定信用卡或购买额度才能生成 API Key。Anthropic API 没有永久免费套餐，但新账号偶尔会有少量赠送额度，注册后可在控制台查看。
国际用户注意：2026 年 6 月曾出现短暂的出口管制限制，但美国商务部已于 7 月 1 日撤销该限制令，Anthropic 随即全面恢复了国际用户访问。如果此前无法访问，现在可以重新尝试。

en: After logging in to console.anthropic.com, navigate to API Keys in the left sidebar. Click "Create Key", give it a descriptive name (for example, your project or application name), and confirm.

The full API key is displayed only once, immediately after creation. Copy it now and store it in a secrets vault, environment variable manager, or password manager. You will not be able to retrieve it again from the console.
zh: 登录 console.anthropic.com 后，点击左侧菜单「API Keys」，点击「Create Key」，填写描述性名称（例如项目或应用名称），确认创建。
API Key 只在创建后完整显示一次，请立即复制并保存到密钥管理系统、环境变量管理器或密码管理器中，之后无法在控制台再次查看完整内容。

en: Navigate to console.anthropic.com/settings/keys
Click "Create Key" → enter a descriptive name → confirm
Copy the key immediately — it starts with sk-ant- and is shown only once
Store it as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in your environment variables
zh: 访问 console.anthropic.com/settings/keys
点击「Create Key」→ 填写名称 → 确认
立即复制 Key（以 sk-ant- 开头），只显示一次
以 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY 保存到环境变量中

heading.en: 5) Your first Claude Fable 5 API call
heading.zh: 5）发起第一次 Claude Fable 5 API 请求

en: Claude Fable 5 uses Anthropic's native API format, not the OpenAI-compatible format. You need the official Anthropic SDK (anthropic-sdk-python or @anthropic-ai/sdk for Node.js). The model ID is claude-fable-5.

Fable 5 supports an optional thinking parameter for deeper analytical work. When thinking is enabled, the model allocates additional compute to problem-solving before generating a final response — ideal for complex coding, multi-step reasoning, or research tasks. Anthropic recommends using the 'high' thinking preset for best results.
zh: Claude Fable 5 使用 Anthropic 原生 API 格式，而非 OpenAI 兼容格式。需要安装官方 Anthropic SDK（Python 用 anthropic-sdk-python，Node.js 用 @anthropic-ai/sdk），模型 ID 为 claude-fable-5。
Fable 5 支持可选的 thinking 参数，用于更深入的分析工作。开启思考模式后，模型会在生成最终响应之前分配额外算力进行问题求解——非常适合复杂编程、多步推理或研究任务。Anthropic 推荐使用 'high' 思考预设以获得最佳效果。

codeBlocks.code:
import anthropic
import os

client = anthropic.Anthropic(
    api_key=os.environ["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"]
)

# Basic call (no thinking)
response = client.messages.create(
    model="claude-fable-5",
    max_tokens=1024,
    messages=[
        {"role": "user", "content": "Explain the Mythos-class safety architecture in Claude Fable 5."}
    ]
)

print(response.content[0].text)

en: Unlike earlier Claude models where extended thinking was an optional feature, Fable 5's adaptive thinking is always active internally — the model continuously allocates reasoning compute based on task complexity. When you enable the thinking parameter in the API, you gain visibility into this process and can control how much compute budget is reserved for it.

The thinking parameter accepts a budget_tokens value that sets the maximum number of tokens for internal reasoning. Higher values produce better results on complex problems but cost more. Anthropic recommends budget_tokens between 5,000 and 15,000 for most complex tasks. The thinking blocks appear in the response alongside the final text block, giving you full transparency into how the model reached its answer.

Practical recommendation: for routine API calls like text generation or simple Q&A, skip the thinking parameter to keep costs low. Enable thinking with a budget of 8,000–12,000 tokens for multi-file refactors, algorithmic design, or multi-step reasoning tasks.
zh: 与早期 Claude 模型将扩展思考作为可选功能不同，Fable 5 的自适应思考始终在内部运行——模型会根据任务复杂度动态分配推理算力。在 API 中启用 thinking 参数后，可以可见化这一过程，并控制为其预留的算力预算。
thinking 参数接受 budget_tokens 值，用于设置内部推理的最大 Token 上限。值越高，复杂问题的效果越好，但费用也越高。Anthropic 推荐大多数复杂任务设置 5,000 到 15,000 之间的 budget_tokens。思考块会与最终文本块一起出现在响应中，让你完整了解模型的推理过程。
实用建议：对于常规 API 调用（文本生成、简单问答），跳过 thinking 参数以降低成本；对于多文件重构、算法设计或多步推理任务，启用 thinking 并设置 8,000–12,000 的预算。

heading.en: 7) Common errors and how to fix them

en: Most API errors fall into three categories: authentication failures (401), rate limit exceeded (429), and overloaded servers (529). Fable 5 also has a unique behavior: when a request triggers one of its built-in safety classifiers, Cursor and the API will automatically fall back to Claude Opus 4.8 rather than returning an error. This means your task continues uninterrupted.

The most important thing to verify on a 401 is the header format. Anthropic's API uses x-api-key as the header name — not Authorization: Bearer like OpenAI's API. If you are migrating code from OpenAI, this is the most common mistake.
zh: API 报错大多属于三类：身份验证失败（401）、限流（429）、服务器过载（529）。Fable 5 还有一个特殊行为：当请求触发内置安全分类器时，Cursor 和 API 会自动回退到 Claude Opus 4.8，而不是返回报错——这意味着你的任务不会中断。
遇到 401 时，最重要的是检查请求头格式。Anthropic API 使用 x-api-key 作为请求头名称，而不是 OpenAI 的 Authorization: Bearer 格式。如果是从 OpenAI 迁移代码，这是最常见的错误来源。

en: 401 Unauthorized → check header is x-api-key: <your-key> (NOT Authorization: Bearer)
401 Unauthorized → verify ANTHROPIC_API_KEY has no leading/trailing whitespace
403 Forbidden → your account may not have Fable 5 access; check console.anthropic.com/settings
429 Too Many Requests → implement exponential backoff; check your rate limits in the console
529 Overloaded → retry with backoff; Fable 5 is high-demand, transient overload is normal
Safety auto-fallback → if response seems weaker than expected, check if it was served by Opus 4.8 (response header: x-served-by-model)
zh: 401 Unauthorized → 检查请求头是 x-api-key: <your-key>（不是 Authorization: Bearer）
401 Unauthorized → 检查 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY 前后无多余空格
403 Forbidden → 账号可能没有 Fable 5 访问权限，在 console.anthropic.com/settings 检查
429 Too Many Requests → 实现指数退避重试；在控制台查看速率限制
529 Overloaded → 带退避逻辑重试；Fable 5 需求量大，短暂过载属正常现象
安全自动回退 → 若响应质量低于预期，检查响应头 x-served-by-model 是否为 Opus 4.8

en: Fable 5 is priced at $10 per million input tokens and $50 per million output tokens. Cache writes cost $12.50/M and cache reads cost $1/M — making prompt caching especially valuable for long-context applications. This is exactly twice the price of Claude Opus 4.8 ($5/$15 per M), and roughly in line with GPT-5.5's premium tier.

Against the benchmark gains, the cost increase is justified for the right workloads. At Fable 5's SWE-bench accuracy (95.0% vs. Opus 4.8's 69.2%), agentic coding tasks that previously required multiple re-attempts can often be resolved in a single pass — reducing total token spend per completed task even at higher per-token rates.

For cost-sensitive workloads that don't require frontier capability, Claude Sonnet 5 ($3/$15 per M) remains an excellent choice. The recommended strategy is to use Fable 5 for complex multi-step agents and high-stakes code generation, and Sonnet 5 for high-volume, lighter tasks.
zh: Fable 5 定价为输入 $10/M Tokens、输出 $50/M Tokens。缓存写入 $12.50/M，缓存读取 $1/M——对长上下文应用，Prompt 缓存非常重要。这正是 Claude Opus 4.8（$5/$15/M）的两倍，与 GPT-5.5 高端档位大体相当。
对照基准测试的提升来看，合适的场景下这个成本增幅是合理的。Fable 5 在 SWE-bench 上准确率（95.0% vs Opus 4.8 的 69.2%）更高，许多之前需要多次重试的 Agent 编程任务可以一次完成——即使单价更高，每个已完成任务的总 Token 消耗反而可能更低。
对于不需要前沿能力的成本敏感场景，Claude Sonnet 5（$3/$15/M）仍是优选。推荐策略：Fable 5 用于复杂多步 Agent 和高要求代码生成；Sonnet 5 用于大批量、轻量级任务。

en: Claude Fable 5: $10 input / $50 output (cache write $12.5 / cache read $1) — per million tokens
Claude Opus 4.8: $5 input / $15 output — per million tokens
Claude Sonnet 5: $3 input / $15 output — per million tokens
GPT-5.5 (OpenAI): ~$10 input / $40 output — per million tokens
Grok 4.5 (xAI): $2 input / $6 output — per million tokens
Fable 5 thinking: additional tokens consumed by budget_tokens billed at standard input rate
zh: Claude Fable 5：$10 输入 / $50 输出（缓存写入 $12.5 / 缓存读取 $1）——每百万 Tokens
Claude Opus 4.8：$5 输入 / $15 输出——每百万 Tokens
Claude Sonnet 5：$3 输入 / $15 输出——每百万 Tokens
GPT-5.5（OpenAI）：约 $10 输入 / $40 输出——每百万 Tokens
Grok 4.5（xAI）：$2 输入 / $6 输出——每百万 Tokens
Fable 5 思考模式：budget_tokens 消耗的 Token 按标准输入费率计费

heading.en: 9) Fable 5 vs. Mythos 5 — what's the difference?

en: Fable 5 and Mythos 5 share the same model weights — they are the same neural network. The difference is entirely in the safety layer. Fable 5 has Anthropic's standard multi-layer safety classifiers applied on top, which intercept requests in high-risk categories (certain cybersecurity, biomedical, and weapons-related topics) and either decline or fall back to Opus 4.8.

Mythos 5 has no public safety guardrails and is available only through Anthropic's "Project Glasswing" program to vetted government cyber-defense contractors, critical infrastructure operators, and compliant biomedical research institutions. It is not available for purchase through the standard API.

For the vast majority of developers, Fable 5 is functionally identical to Mythos 5 — the safety classifiers only affect edge cases that legitimate commercial applications would not hit. If you encounter an unexpected fallback to Opus 4.8, it almost certainly means the specific prompt pattern triggered a classifier, not that the model itself lacks capability.
zh: Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 共享完全相同的模型权重——它们是同一个神经网络。区别完全在于安全层。Fable 5 叠加了 Anthropic 标准的多层安全分类器，会拦截高风险类别的请求（特定网络安全、生物医学、武器相关话题），要么拒绝，要么回退到 Opus 4.8。
Mythos 5 没有公开安全护栏，仅通过 Anthropic 的「Project Glasswing」计划，向经过审核的政府网络防御承包商、关键基础设施运营商和合规生物医学研究机构定向开放，无法通过标准 API 购买。
对绝大多数开发者来说，Fable 5 在功能上与 Mythos 5 完全一致——安全分类器只影响合规商业应用不会触及的边界情况。如果遇到意外的 Opus 4.8 回退，几乎可以确定是特定的提示词模式触发了分类器，而非模型本身能力不足。

question.en: Is Claude Fable 5 the same as Claude Mythos 5?
question.zh: Claude Fable 5 和 Claude Mythos 5 是同一个模型吗？

answer.en: They share the same underlying model weights ('Capybara' architecture). The difference is the safety layer: Fable 5 has standard commercial safety classifiers and is publicly available; Mythos 5 has no public guardrails and is restricted to vetted government and security institutions only.
answer.zh: 两者共享相同的底层模型权重（Capybara 架构）。区别在于安全层：Fable 5 具有标准商业安全分类器，面向公众开放；Mythos 5 没有公开安全护栏，仅面向经审核的政府和安全机构。

question.en: Does Fable 5 use the OpenAI SDK format?
question.zh: Fable 5 使用 OpenAI SDK 格式吗？

answer.en: No. Fable 5 uses Anthropic's native Messages API. The key differences: use x-api-key header (not Authorization: Bearer), use the @anthropic-ai/sdk or anthropic Python package, and the response format uses content blocks instead of choices[0].message. If you need OpenAI-compatible access, some third-party providers offer an adapter.
answer.zh: 不。Fable 5 使用 Anthropic 原生 Messages API。主要区别：请求头使用 x-api-key（不是 Authorization: Bearer），使用 @anthropic-ai/sdk 或 anthropic Python 包，响应格式使用 content blocks 而非 choices[0].message。如需 OpenAI 兼容访问，部分第三方服务商提供适配层。

question.en: Can I use adaptive thinking on every request?
question.zh: 每次请求都可以启用自适应思考吗？

answer.en: Yes, but it is not necessary for every request. For simple Q&A or text generation, skip the thinking parameter — it adds cost without much benefit. For complex coding, multi-step reasoning, or long-form analysis, enable thinking with a budget_tokens of 8,000–12,000 for best results.
answer.zh: 可以，但并非每次请求都有必要。对于简单问答或文本生成，跳过 thinking 参数——它会增加费用但收益不大。对于复杂编程、多步推理或长篇分析，建议启用思考并设置 budget_tokens 为 8,000–12,000。

question.en: Is Fable 5 available on Amazon Bedrock and Google Vertex AI?
question.zh: Fable 5 在 Amazon Bedrock 和 Google Vertex AI 上可用吗？

answer.en: Yes. Claude Fable 5 is available through Anthropic's direct API, Amazon Bedrock (model ID: anthropic.claude-fable-5-v1), and Google Cloud Vertex AI. Enterprise teams using existing AWS or GCP billing can access Fable 5 through their preferred cloud platform.
answer.zh: 可以。Claude Fable 5 通过 Anthropic 直接 API、Amazon Bedrock（模型 ID：anthropic.claude-fable-5-v1）和 Google Cloud Vertex AI 均可使用。已使用 AWS 或 GCP 账单的企业团队可通过其偏好的云平台访问 Fable 5。

question.en: What happened with the June 2026 access restriction?
question.zh: 2026 年 6 月的访问限制是怎么回事？

answer.en: On June 12, 2026 — three days after launch — the US Department of Commerce issued an emergency export control order. Anthropic was given a 90-minute compliance window and suspended international access to both Fable 5 and Mythos 5. After 18 days of negotiations, Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick signed the order reversal on June 30, and Anthropic restored full global access on July 1, 2026.
answer.zh: 2026 年 6 月 12 日——发布三天后——美国商务部发布紧急出口管制令，Anthropic 仅获 90 分钟合规窗口，被迫暂停 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 的国际访问。经 18 天密集谈判，商务部长 Howard Lutnick 于 6 月 30 日签字撤销管制令，Anthropic 于 2026 年 7 月 1 日恢复全球访问。
